CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP_Delete] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT DISTINCT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'NA' AS CustomerId
,BDA.START_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
,BDA.END_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
,BDA.CUST_ID AS CoreCustomerId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,BDA.DEL_FLG AS DeletedIndicator
,BDA.GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,BDA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BDA.PROFIT_CERT_FLG AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,BDA.ENTITY_CRE_FLG AS VerifiedIndicator
,BDA.MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,BDA.CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,BDA.ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM AS SerialNumber
,BDA.ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,BDA.CUST_RELTN_CODE AS CustomerRelationCode
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS LinkCode
,CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(BDA.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) as FILE_DATE
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDA.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP_CM139_20231129 BDA
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_CM139_20231129 BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDA.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
where BDA.Isactive = '0' and  BDA.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'

)




SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountParticipationNote)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
)

,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,CoreCustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerAccountParticipationNote)
,convert(integer,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(char,ProfitCertificateIndicator)
,convert(char,VerifiedIndicator)
,convert(char,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator)
,convert(char,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator)
,convert(varchar,SerialNumber)
,convert(integer,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount)
,convert(varchar,CustomerRelationCode)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, SerialNumber, CustomerId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP'
)

,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.SerialNumber,TGT.SerialNumber) AS SerialNumber
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW = TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
AND SRC.CustomerID  = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
)
SELECT *INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, SRC.FILE_DATE)
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND  DELTA.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber 
AND  DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND  DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
 AND SRC.SerialNumber = TGT.SerialNumber
  AND SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
   AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
--WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' 



--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CoreCustomerId
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,DeletedIndicator
,GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,FinancialInstitutionId
,ProfitCertificateIndicator
,VerifiedIndicator
,MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SerialNumber
,RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,CustomerRelationCode
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,LinkCode
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(varchar, SRC.CustomerId) as CustomerId
,SRC.FILE_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31'AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.CoreCustomerId AS CoreCustomerId
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationNote AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,'Y' AS DeletedIndicator
,SRC.GuarantorLiabilityPercentage AS GuarantorLiabilityPercentage
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.ProfitCertificateIndicator AS ProfitCertificateIndicator
,SRC.VerifiedIndicator AS VerifiedIndicator
,SRC.MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator AS MinorToMajorLetterGenerationIndicator
,SRC.ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator AS ChangedDueToAssumptionIndicator
,SRC.SerialNumber AS SerialNumber
,SRC.RelatedPartyAllowedAmount AS RelatedPartyAllowedAmount
,SRC.CustomerRelationCode AS CustomerRelationCode
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,SRC.LinkCode AS LinkCode
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
  AND DELTA.SerialNumber = SRC.SerialNumber
   AND ISNULL(DELTA.CustomerId,'1') = ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,'1')
    AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;


END
GO
